text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I made a new concoction! I'm going to try it now, so watch me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Indeed. This one is exclusively for Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It deals with a peculiar microorganism rumored to be found only in the musculoskeletal system of Umamusume…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It's called Umamusuchondria! My groundbreaking new drug is designed to prove its existence!
choice_data_list: It's the first time I've ever heard of that microorganism…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That's because it hasn't been proven yet!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Anyway! There's a chance that taking this will cause some sort of mutation in my body.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: So, be prepared to document anything or call a doctor in case of emergency!
choice_data_list: I'm not so sure about this.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It's only by going beyond uncertainty that we can expand our potential!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now, let the experiment begin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon enthusiastically swallows the suspiciously-colored liquid. And then…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh?! I'm feeling a sudden burst of power!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I can feel it surging… But, hm? This wasn't the intended effect.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: If successful, the Umamusuchondria should have spoken to me…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sigh… A failure, it is then. No, wait. This power I feel in my legs… Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems that this wasn't the result she expected. But I'm glad to hear she got a burst of strength…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At any rate, what the heck is Umamusuchondria?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: So, be prepared to document anything or call a doctor in case of emergency!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That's what I like to hear! All right, let's do this! Begin the experiment!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon enthusiastically swallows the suspiciously-colored liquid. And then…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What the heck is this?! So much power… Oh, oooh?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ugh… And… now a sudden crash!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm… It seemed my legs were becoming stronger, but… at the same time, my energy was being severely drained.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This wasn't what I expected to happen, but… Hmm, how should I interpret this?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems that this wasn't the result she expected. But I'm glad to hear she got a burst of strength…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At any rate, what the heck is Umamusuchondria?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: So, be prepared to document anything or call a doctor in case of emergency!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes! Here's to the future of Umamusume-kind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon enthusiastically swallows the suspiciously-colored liquid. And then…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's this? …Did I pass out and end up dreaming?

text_block_list.name: Umamusuchondria
text_block_list.text: Tachyon… Agnes Tachyon… Listen to us…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Gasp! This is… information pouring into my head! That's it! The Umamusuchondria!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …Trainer! Hurry, the notebook… No! The whiteboard—anything! I must write down my thoughts!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! My memory's fading! The precious information that'll change the future of Umamusume-kind! Faster! Hurry! Hurryyy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With this strange experience, Agnes Tachyon's ability rises dramatically.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, it seems she's unfortunately been unable to make further contact with the Umamusuchondria.
